critical_code_review_comments: STAGED REPLACE (import_service.py:985-1027): correctly inserts into staging_collection_name FIRST, validates staged_count == parsed count, THEN delete_many + insert_many on the real collection, THEN post-swap final count check. The `finally: await staging.drop()` ensures no orphan collections. Excellent pattern — the swap window is O(seconds) but if it crashes mid-swap the previous audit rows in finance_imports remain intact. NOTE: the swap itself is NOT transactional across the two operations (delete_many followed by insert_many) — if the process is killed between them, finance_open_documents will be empty until the NEXT import. Consider MongoDB transactions or a two-collection alias-swap pattern if you need stricter guarantees at scale.

ROUTE ORDERING (routes.py:1373-1424): /imports/cleanup/preview and /imports/cleanup are declared BEFORE POST /imports/{import_type} — verified via curl that both cleanup endpoints return 200/valid JSON (not 422 enum validation error). Comment at line 1370 documents the constraint clearly.
PAGINATION (routes.py:1323-1366): total, limit, offset, has_more all present in response; has_more computed correctly as `(offset + len(imports)) < total`. LGTM.
CLEANUP AUDIT PRESERVATION (routes.py:1467-1475): $set updates only original_file_path/file_cleaned_at/file_cleaned_by — no other fields touched, so `errors` array is preserved. Good.

SEND-EMAIL RESILIENCE (routes.py:1961-2066): even when RESEND_API_KEY is empty OR Resend raises, the finance_actions row is STILL inserted (sent=false, error populated) — matches spec 'não bloqueia a operação da cobradora'. The residual-only guardrail is enforced against COLLECTIONS_AGENT only, so OWNER/FINANCE_REVIEWER bypass; verified.
EMAIL TEMPLATE KEY pattern is `^[a-z0-9_]+$` (Pydantic) — enforced at model layer. My initial test used uppercase and got 422, which is CORRECT.

DUNNING BUCKETS: _resolve_bucket() checks financial_status FIRST (PROMESSA_ATIVA/EM_DISPUTA/BLOQUEADO — enum values are UPPERCASE PROMESSA_ATIVA etc.), then falls through to days-based buckets. Fallback to DUNNING_BUCKETS[-1] for days<0 or days>120000. LGTM.

FRONTEND QuickCommunicationPanel: bucket colour classes are hard-coded per bucket.key (green/yellow/orange/red/black/blue/purple) — matches backend palette. The disabled state for WhatsApp/Email when no phone/email is correct UX and prevents wasted clicks.

TIMELINE (FinanceClientDetail.js:455-490): groups actions by day using ISO date, renders history-day-{iso} + history-item-{id} testids. Icon and colour differ per action_type as spec'd (email=blue mail icon, regularization=orange etc.). LGTM.
